frame.note: Camera-aligned full-screen quad: for a screen point at NDC (nx, ny) with the live camera, tx = nx * tan(hfov/2), ty = ny * tan(vfov/2) (hfov/vfov = camera's current fovs), then plate px = (axisPx.x + tx * pxPerTan, axisPx.y - ty * pxPerTan) and uv = (px.x / w, 1 - px.y / h) for a flipY texture. The concept's 9:16 frame is exactly the reference view (hfov spans conceptRectPx width).

camera.fitRule: aspect <= 9:16: hold hfovDeg (vfov = 2 atan(tan(hfov/2) / aspect)); aspect > 9:16 never happens (9:16 column)
camera.note: THREE.PerspectiveCamera: camera.position.set(...position); camera.rotation.set(...rotation) with rotation.order 'YXZ'; camera.fov = vfov for the live aspect. Solved from the painted landmarks with a real-scale field.

fit.note: px at the concept's 1x scale (1024 wide); at 390 CSS px wide divide by 2.63. The mound is painted closer and deeper than regulation, see anchors.machine.

machine.note: position = where the 3D machine stands: the ground centre of the GLB box whose front bottom edge sits on the painted machine's base (wheels / feet) and whose top edge projects onto the painted top, under this camera (tools/plates/machine_fit.py). The concepts paint the machine on the FRONT of the mound, often metres closer than the mound centre (uv) or regulation (regulationSpotUv, z = -18.14). conceptHeightM = the height the 3D machine is scaled to; conceptWidthM = the painted body width at that depth (the GLB is narrower).

paintedMound.note: the painted mound as an ellipse on the ground (y = 0) under this camera

batter.note: conceptFeet = where the concept's batter stands under this camera (feet midpoint, approximate); conceptStanceHeightM = ground to helmet top of the painted stance at that depth (hero scale).

batterConcept.note: Hand-measured painted batter; more accurate than anchors.batter (whose 'head' is the top of the painted bat). Fit #23's idle stance to this screen span. Reference implementation: preview_plates/src/game/batter.js fitToPlate().

lines.note: wallBase = painted wall base (fit); wallTop = projected 3D fence top (wallHeight m) under the solved camera

lighting.mood: clear night: crisp white floodlights from the right, navy fill, cool rim
lighting.note: dir points from the scene TOWARD the light. Shadows fall on the invisible ground (y = 0). Intensities assume physically-based THREE lights with ACES-ish tonemapping.

fog.note: for 3D things far out (the batted ball near the wall): fade toward the painting's far-field colour

sprites.name: jet
sprites.note: the big jet on approach, flies left to right across the sky and leaves the frame; respawn after 40-90 s.

sprites.name: jet_far
sprites.note: the small distant plane, drifts right to left, slower; respawn after 60-120 s.
